name: Arcane Archer — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Arcane Archer from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's pages "Arcane Archer", "Arcane Archer" but are not part of the Arcane Archer entry, which is unchanged.

From d20pfsrd.com: Arcane Archer

Spells per Day

Editor’s Note

Does a wizard (or other character that uses a spellbook), receive bonus spells to add to his spellbook when he gains a level in a prestige class that grants an increase to spellcasting? No. The increase to his spellcasting level does not grant any other benefits, except for spells per day, spells known (for spontaneous casters), and an increase to his overall caster level. He must spend time and gold to add new spells to his spellbook.

From d20pfsrd.com: Arcane Archer

Enhance Arrows (Su)

At 1st level the arcane archer’s arrows are automatically enchanted when nocked and fired by them, gaining a +1 enhancement bonus. This  bonus stacks with the bow’s existing enhancement bonus if  (to a maximum of +5). At later levels he is also able to apply special abilities to his arrows on top of any granted by his bow. Only one ability can be selected per day, and can be changed after 8 hours of rest.
